title: Oahu Private Tour Customizable
includes: Guide with a camera to help capture special moments (not a professional photoshoot)
Cruise Ship Terminals Pick-Up/Drop-Off (Traveling with luggage? Maximum of 3 passengers)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is a fully private tour of Oahu’s Circle Island route. The listed 8-hour itinerary is a carefully curated mix of the island’s highlights, designed for guests who prefer an easy, relaxed day and don’t want to customize. Because the tour is private, your day can also be fully built around your interests, pace, and priorities. Your guide will review options at pickup, make recommendations, and adjust throughout the day as needed. If you want to plan your tour ahead of time, just reach out, we’re happy to design the itinerary together with you.

- Personalization: Every tour is designed around you.
- Connection: We share the stories behind the places we visit.
- Respect: For the land, the culture, and your experience.
